messages:
michele: hey team :wave: received my monitor and KVM switch this morning. when i plug the USB-C dock into the KVM the keyboard/mouse intermittently disconnects and the monitor goes blank for a second. also i'm seeing the corp wifi SSO prompt keep popping up on the mac even after i sign in. any tips?
eli_it: welcome Michele! can you tell us the monitor model + KVM brand? and which macOS version?
michele: Monitor is ViewSonic VG27, KVM is 'SwitchMate Pro' (company shipped it with the stand). Mac is MacBook Pro 14" on macOS 13.6.1. Dock is the standard company USB-C dock.
maya: KVMs can be finicky with USB-C alt mode. first quick check: bypass the KVM and plug the dock directly into the laptop — does the keyboard/mouse stay stable? also try a different upstream USB-C cable if you have one.
michele: tried direct to laptop -> keyboard stable, no disconnects. plug back through KVM and it drops again. swapped cable with one from my desk, still flaky.
dylan: likely the KVM's downstream USB hub power or USB handshake issue. two options: 1) update dock firmware (we pushed an update last month that improved KVM compatibility), or 2) we'll swap the KVM for a different model. can you share dock serial?
michele: serial is DCK-9X7-00123.
eli_it: thanks. i'm pushing a firmware update now — will ping when done. for the wifi SSO: is this the certificate-based corpwifi, or the captive-portal 'corp-guest'? if it's cert-based you need the device cert installed via the MDM; if captive portal you should get a browser prompt.
michele: it's 'RedwoodCorp' SSID — it asked me for SSO (browser-based) and then kept prompting after i completed MFA.
dylan: that usually means the network auth cookie isn't persistent because of an HTTP->HTTPS redirect or a local proxy. can you try flushing the mac network cache:`sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder` and then rejoin SSID?
michele: ran the command, rejoined, still getting repeated SSO prompts.
eli_it: created ticket #IT-5428 and added you. it-bot: ticket IT-5428 created and assigned to eli_it. ETA first response in 2 hours.
eli_it: okay, remote next steps: i'll push a quick dock firmware patch and check auth headers from the captive portal. i'll also arrange an overnight swap for the KVM if the patch doesn't fix it. i'll update here in ~30m. :thumbsup:
michele: thanks! appreciate it.
eli_it: firmware push completed. please unplug and replug the dock and test with KVM again.
michele: plugged back in and keyboard is stable! monitor didn't blank on a switch. wifi SSO still prompting though.
dylan: for SSO let's try a temporary test — create a new local network profile: System Preferences -> Network -> + add a new Wi-Fi service, join RedwoodCorp, then open Safari incognito and hit https://auth.redwood.example/status . paste any error if it shows.
michele: in private window i get a 302 redirect to https://sso.redwood.example/login then a 400 Bad Request after login.
dylan: that 400 suggests header/proxy munging. eli, can you check the corpwifi ingress logs for Michele's device mac?
eli_it: checked logs — the gateway saw auth, but our proxy trimmed the cookie domain due to an old routing rule. i've opened a change to fix the header routing (PR link: https://go/repo/infra/wifi-proxy/changes/274). once deployed it'll stop dropping the auth cookie. rolling patch in 10m.
michele: sweet — i'll re-test after deploy. thanks all.
eli_it: deploy finished. rejoin and test one more time.
michele: confirmed — wifi SSO worked and didn't loop. keyboard + monitor also good. thanks everyone! :tada: closing ticket IT-5428 if no further issues.
eli_it: thanks for the quick checks, Michele. ping us if anything else pops up.
